_explication: Des sons candidats, générés à part dans app/audio/essais/ et écoutés sur app/essais-sons.html avant d'entrer dans le jeu (robot « Voix », choix « sons-candidats »). Cinquième essai (3 novembre) : un fond de stade, en boucle, pour remplacer le murmure de tennis trop calme (les chants de supporters doivent en sortir naturellement).

fond_1.texte: Ambience of a packed indoor arena between plays: thousands of spectators murmuring and chatting at once, a warm continuous crowd hum, very occasional distant claps, calm but alive, no music, no announcer, no whistle, steady level without sudden peaks, seamless loop

fond_2.texte: Ambience of a full sports arena during a big match: a dense continuous crowd buzz, thousands of fans talking excitedly, scattered distant cheers and claps here and there, energetic but steady, no music, no announcer, no whistle, steady level without sudden peaks, seamless loop

fond_3.texte: Ambience of a lively stadium crowd before a decisive point: a loud continuous roar of thousands of supporters, distant chanting voices blending into the crowd, occasional drums far away, constant energy, no music, no announcer, no whistle, steady level without sudden peaks, seamless loop
